resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com says removed about 1950; Idaho Fire Lookouts says removed in the 1950s; the Forest Service list says destroyed 1950. The story says removed or destroyed and does not pick one word.
All three sources give 1930 as the build year. The Forest Service's +/- sits in its Photos column beside a 1939 photo date, not beside the build year, so the story does not call 1930 approximate.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Removal versus destruction around 1950 conflicts across sources. The 1930s camp comes from a decade-only listing. No staffing is documented by any source. No source describes what remains on the ridge; the site is a wilderness-adjacent hike-in.
